name: Serpent
overview: The Scripture presents the serpent as a subtle and cunning creature, as seen in Genesis 3:1, where it challenges God's command to Eve. This subtlety leads to deception, as the serpent denies the consequences of disobedience and tempts Eve to eat the forbidden fruit (Genesis 3:4-6). Through this account, the serpent symbolizes the origin of temptation and the entrance of sin into the human experience.
